name: Calendar
author: Benjamin Werner
description: Replaces the Omarchy clock with one whose calendar popup shows your actual appointments. Days carrying events are marked with a dot per calendar, and clicking a day lists that day's agenda under the grid. Clicking an entry opens a pane beside the calendar with the full invitation -- when, how often, where, organiser, who accepted, and the notes; entries with a video call get an icon that joins it. A settings screen switches individual calendars off and decides whether finished entries are dimmed or dropped. Events come from a pluggable exporter that writes a documented JSON file; a Thunderbird exporter ships with the plugin and reads its calendar caches read-only, expanding recurring series, exceptions and moved occurrences itself.

barWidget.description: Date/time label with a calendar popup that shows your appointments.
